newsitem.title: USA: Brown Brothers group cuts Nuevo Energy stake.
newsitem.headline: Brown Brothers group cuts Nuevo Energy stake.

text.p: A group including Brown Brothers Harriman & Co said Thursday it reduced its stake in Nuevo Energy Co to the equivalent of 928,607 common shares or about 4.8 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 235,000 common shares between August 19 and September 11 at prices ranging from $35.50 to $40.70 a share.

The group previously held the equivalent of a 6.0 percent stake, or 1,163,607 common shares. Its current stake includes 913,402 shares it will receive on conversion of preferred shares, according to the filing.
